zh-CN.headlineFull: 规则、AI与增长风险；经营边界同步重写
zh-CN.intro: 欧盟小包关税、联合国AI治理、全球增长、健康、气候与贸易共同显示：扩张必须匹配治理能力。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 机会在扩张，真正稀缺的是把规则、技术和风险一起管好的能力。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 今天不是一个警报，而是一整排仪表盘同时亮灯。

en-US.headlineFull: Rules, AI and growth risks; rewrite business boundaries together
en-US.intro: EU parcel duties, UN AI governance, global growth, health, climate and trade all show that expansion must be matched by governance capacity.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Opportunity is expanding; the scarce capability is managing rules, technology and risk together.
en-US.doudouQuote: Today is not one alarm; it is a whole dashboard lighting up.

sources.title: EU applies €3 customs duty per item on low-value e-commerce consignments
Preliminary Report
sources.publisher: United Nations Independent International Scientific Panel on AI

zh-CN.headlineFact: 欧盟低值包裹每件征收€3
zh-CN.headlineView: 卖家必须重算落地成本
zh-CN.headlineFull: 欧盟低值包裹每件征收€3；卖家必须重算落地成本
zh-CN.intro: €150以下商品免税门槛取消，临时每件€3关税已实施；IOSS、商品识别和结账透明度更关键。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 跨境转化率越来越取决于顾客下单前能否看到真实总价。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 便宜包裹不再等于简单包裹。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：跨境电商｜开放热点。

en-US.headlineFull: EU charges €3 per low-value item; sellers must recalculate landed cost
en-US.intro: The duty exemption for goods under €150 has ended and a temporary €3 duty per item is in force; IOSS, product identification and checkout transparency matter more.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Cross-border conversion increasingly depends on showing the true total before checkout.
en-US.doudouQuote: A cheap parcel is no longer a simple parcel.

sources.title: EU applies €3 customs duty per item on low-value e-commerce consignments

zh-CN.headlineFact: 联合国AI报告提出七大治理域
zh-CN.headlineFull: 联合国AI报告提出七大治理域；证据必须追上能力
zh-CN.intro: 报告覆盖技术轨迹、经济、安全、环境、人权、文化与可靠治理，为全球AI对话建立共同科学起点。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: AI治理不能等所有证据齐全才开始，行动与验证必须并行。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 赛车已经上路，地图和护栏得边跑边补。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：人工智能 AI。

en-US.headlineFact: UN maps seven AI governance domains
en-US.headlineView: evidence must catch up with capability
en-US.headlineFull: UN maps seven AI governance domains; evidence must catch up with capability
en-US.intro: The report covers technical trajectories, economics, security, environment, rights, culture and reliable governance, creating a common scientific baseline for global AI dialogue.
en-US.xiaziQuote: AI governance cannot wait for perfect evidence; action and validation must advance together.
en-US.doudouQuote: The race car is moving, so the map and guardrails must catch up.

sources.title: Preliminary Report
sources.publisher: United Nations Independent International Scientific Panel on AI

zh-CN.headlineFull: 单人创业申请增长逾20%；AI正在成为第一位员工
zh-CN.intro: Nasdaq报告显示单人企业申请自2025年初增长逾20%；AI降低固定成本，也放大创始人的判断与责任。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: AI让一个人能做更多，但不会替创始人承担最后责任。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 团队变轻了，决策背包反而更重。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：一人公司 OPC。

en-US.headlineView: AI is becoming the first hire
en-US.headlineFull: Solo business applications rise over 20%; AI is becoming the first hire
en-US.intro: A Nasdaq report says one-person business applications have risen more than 20% since early 2025; AI lowers fixed costs while amplifying founder judgment and responsibility.
en-US.xiaziQuote: AI helps one person do more, but it cannot carry the founder's final responsibility.
en-US.doudouQuote: The team is lighter, but the decision backpack is heavier.

sources.title: New Nasdaq Report Finds That AI Is Driving Entrepreneurship

zh-CN.headlineFull: 2026全球增长降至2.5%；能源冲击推高通胀
zh-CN.intro: 世界银行称中东冲突与能源、融资成本上升正在拖慢全球增长；发展中经济体与就业市场承受的压力更加明显。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 低增长时代，现金流韧性比漂亮的扩张故事更重要。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 风变小了，船就更要看油量和航线。

en-US.headlineFull: 2026 global growth falls to 2.5%; energy shock lifts inflation
en-US.intro: The World Bank says Middle East conflict and higher energy and financing costs are slowing growth, with developing economies under greater pressure.
en-US.xiaziQuote: In a low-growth era, cash-flow resilience matters more than a polished expansion story.
en-US.doudouQuote: When the wind weakens, watch the fuel and route more closely.

sources.title: Middle East Conflict Sends Global Growth to Lowest Rate Since COVID-19

zh-CN.headlineFact: 最多45%失智风险可预防或延缓
zh-CN.headlineFull: 最多45%失智风险可预防或延缓；干预必须更早发生
zh-CN.intro: WHO新指南把运动、教育、心血管健康与社会连接等可干预因素纳入更早阶段的持续行动与公共健康管理。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 公共健康最有价值的投资，往往发生在疾病确诊之前。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 大脑也需要长期保养，不是坏了才修。

en-US.headlineFact: Up to 45% of dementia risk is preventable
en-US.headlineFull: Up to 45% of dementia risk is preventable; intervention must start earlier
en-US.intro: New WHO guidance brings modifiable factors such as exercise, education, cardiovascular health and social connection into earlier action.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The most valuable public-health investment often happens before diagnosis.
en-US.doudouQuote: The brain needs maintenance too, not repairs only after failure.

sources.title: New WHO guidelines: up to 45% of dementia risk could be prevented or delayed

zh-CN.headlineFact: 受控燃烧使红杉存活率接近4倍
zh-CN.headlineView: 防灾要从燃料负荷开始
zh-CN.headlineFull: 受控燃烧使红杉存活率接近4倍；防灾要从燃料负荷开始
zh-CN.intro: 一项NASA支持的研究显示，提前通过受控燃烧清理可燃物，能显著降低极端火灾中的巨型红杉死亡风险。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 韧性不是灾后恢复，而是灾前主动减少系统脆弱点。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 小火管得好，大火就少一份燃料。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：气候与森林。

en-US.headlineFact: Controlled burns nearly quadruple sequoia survival
en-US.headlineFull: Controlled burns nearly quadruple sequoia survival; resilience starts with fuel loads
en-US.intro: A NASA-funded study found that reducing burnable material in advance sharply lowers giant sequoia mortality during extreme wildfire.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Resilience is not only recovery; it is reducing weak points before disaster.
en-US.doudouQuote: Manage the small fires and the big one gets less fuel.

sources.title: Previous prescribed burns saved thousands of ancient sequoias during historically unprecedented wildfires

zh-CN.headlineFact: 美印卫星揭示南极蜂鸟冰貌
zh-CN.headlineView: 高分辨率观测进入新阶段
zh-CN.headlineFull: 美印卫星揭示南极蜂鸟冰貌；高分辨率观测进入新阶段
zh-CN.intro: NISAR雷达数据展示冰川流动、海冰与地表结构，帮助研究人员持续追踪东南极冰盖变化及其长期趋势。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 看清变化的速度，才有机会把气候决策做在拐点之前。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 卫星不怕云，冰面的细节藏不住了。

en-US.headlineView: high-resolution monitoring enters a new phase
en-US.headlineFull: US-India satellite reveals Antarctic hummingbird; high-resolution monitoring enters a new phase
en-US.intro: NISAR radar data shows glacier motion and surface structure, helping scientists track ice-sheet change continuously.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Seeing the pace of change creates a chance to act before the tipping point.
en-US.doudouQuote: Clouds cannot hide the ice details from radar.

sources.title: NASA-ISRO NISAR Satellite Opens Data Vault, Shows Antarctic Hummingbird

zh-CN.headlineFact: WTO发布150多个经济体关税画像
zh-CN.headlineFull: WTO发布150多个经济体关税画像；非关税措施同样关键
zh-CN.intro: 新版资料同时呈现约束税率、实际税率、产品组与贸易救济措施，出口决策需要看完整规则栈。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 真正的市场准入成本，从来不只是一行关税数字。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 门票看完了，别忘了门口还有一整套规则。

en-US.headlineFact: WTO profiles tariffs in over 150 economies
en-US.headlineFull: WTO profiles tariffs in over 150 economies; non-tariff measures matter too
en-US.intro: The new edition combines bound and applied tariffs, product groups and trade-remedy measures, so exporters can assess the full rule stack.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The real cost of market access is never just one tariff line.
en-US.doudouQuote: After reading the ticket price, check the whole entrance rulebook.

sources.title: WTO issues new edition of World Tariff Profiles
